sp-acj4-1-real

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R}\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \arcsin\left(\left|x\right|\right) \overset{?}{=} \left|\arcsin x\right|\)
Expected
contingent true at \(x = 0\); false at \(x = 2\)

equal at some admissible points, different at others

witness (true): \(x = 0\)

witness (false): \(x = 2\)

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0 -> abs asin _0

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-1-real (category simplipy-real)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[1] + rules.json[0]: asin abs _0  ->  abs asin _0")
  (var x real)
  (ask (= (asin (abs x)) (abs (asin x))))
  (expect contingent)
  (witness true (x 0) (lean-proof "norm_num [AE.abs_eq, AE.pow, AE.w2_asin_zero, AE.w2_asin_one, AE.w2_acos_zero, AE.w2_acos_one, AE.w2_atan_zero, AE.w2_atanh_zero, AE.w2_asinh_zero, AE.w2_acosh_one, AE.surd, AE.w2_zero_ne_I, AE.w2_isInt_three, AE.w2_isInt_five, AE.w2_isInt_nine, AE.w2_isInt_neg_five, AE.w2_odd_three, AE.w2_odd_five, AE.w2_odd_nine, AE.w2_odd_neg_five, Real.pi_pos, Complex.exp_re, Real.exp_pos]"))
  (witness false (x 2) (lean-proof "constructorm* _ ∧ _ <;> first | exact AE.w2_r1w2 | norm_num [AE.abs_eq, AE.pow, AE.w2_asin_zero, AE.w2_asin_one, AE.w2_acos_zero, AE.w2_acos_one, AE.w2_atan_zero, AE.w2_atanh_zero, AE.w2_asinh_zero, AE.w2_acosh_one, AE.surd, AE.w2_zero_ne_I, AE.w2_isInt_three, AE.w2_isInt_five, AE.w2_isInt_nine, AE.w2_isInt_neg_five, AE.w2_odd_three, AE.w2_odd_five, AE.w2_odd_nine, AE.w2_odd_neg_five, Real.pi_pos, Complex.exp_re, Real.exp_pos]")))
